question: Where a block made up of several control areas sizes both its restoration and replacement reserves on the block's combined imbalances, what must all of its TSOs do about simultaneous counteracting reserve activations inside the block?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 146(9) says that where an LFC block has more than one LFC area and FRR and RR reserve capacity is sized on LFC block imbalances, all TSOs of the block must implement an imbalance netting process. They must also interchange the maximum amount of imbalance netting power defined in paragraph 6 with the other LFC areas of the block. This matches the reference answer.", "other_articles": [], "ambiguity": "none", "ambiguity_reason": "The question closely paraphrases Article 146(9), and no other article imposes this obligation.", "suggested_fix": ""}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 146(9) says that where an LFC block has more than one LFC area and FRR and RR reserve capacity is sized on LFC block imbalances, all TSOs of the block must implement an imbalance netting process. They must also interchange the maximum amount of imbalance netting power defined in paragraph 6 with the other LFC areas of the block. This matches the reference answer.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question closely paraphrases Article 146(9), and no other article imposes this obligation.
